title: Doodling Dumbo Octopus
statement: In a twilight-blue tank strewn with sea glass and a tidy spiral of collected shells, this small, ear-finned octopus drifts up to the glass whenever someone lingers, tilts its head as if considering a question, and sketches a glowing answer in the water with the tip of one arm. The doodles fade within moments, so it simply draws another, endlessly curious about whoever is watching.
